description: This file defines the ModuleInstallerInterface in Drupal, specifying methods for installing, uninstalling, and validating modules, including handling dependencies and validators.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Extension\ModuleInstallerInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for module installation, uninstallation, and validation in Drupal.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a list of modules, handling dependencies and invoking relevant hooks.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a list of modules, with optional dependents removal, and validation.

methods.name: addUninstallValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator for module uninstallation; deprecated in Drupal 11.1.0.

methods.name: validateUninstall
methods.description: Checks if modules can be uninstalled, returning reasons if not.
